{{Quote|We test a new weapon, of my own design, which is capable of catastrophic destruction. A weapon which will destroy organic matter, but leave machines unharmed.|Lok Durd to Count Dooku on a defoliator|audio=LokDurd2.flac|<ref name="Defenders of Peace">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>}}
A '''defoliator''' was a weapon designed to destroy organic matter while leaving machinery intact. The defoliator was mounted on a [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]], also known as a DDT.

==Description==
[[File:Defoliator_loaded.png|thumb|left|180px|[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] load the Defoliator.]]
The defoliator used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] consisted of an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapon attached to the chassis of a modified [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]]. Standard artillery shells which contained the defoliator weapon were placed within the launching mechanism and fired at a target. Upon impact, the warhead detonated, generating a fiery shockwave that engulfed a large area, obliterating all forms of organic matter but leaving machinery intact. The weapon had a weakness in that the shockwave could not breach [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].

==History==
The first known defoliator, designed by a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[General/Legends|general]] named [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]], was created as an experimental weapon during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the CIS. It was being tested by Durd, who had discovered the isolated world of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. After finding a [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] [[Lurmen village/Legends|colony]] on the planet, Lok Durd established an outpost in order to test the Separatists' newest weapon, designed to destroy organic matter. This weapon was used in action during the [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|Battle of Maridun]], where it was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

Also, when [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|sent]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to invade [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] as revenge for [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Ventress]]' betrayal, they deployed a Defoliator tank. The tank helped burn down the forest and lead Grievous to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Nightsister fortress|village]], but was finally destroyed by a [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tank]] which was occupied by Ventress.

[[File:Defoliator_explosion.png|thumb|left|180px|The Defoliator is tested on two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].]]

Many years later, a similar weapon was employed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|forces]] who sought to starve the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] out of their [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]. Special craft were used to destroy any source of food for the [[The Colony|Killik Colony]]. [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], after being brought to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] by [[Raynar Thul]], helped drive the Chiss defoliators away from the Killiks' food stocks.

These defoliator weapons were also used extensively in the [[Swarm War]] by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The Chiss defoliators were notably different in that they consisted of special craft used to destroy food matter in order to starve the inhabitants of a planet.
